skill.name: scientific-slides
skill.description: Build research presentations for conferences, seminars, defenses, and scientific talks. The skill provides slide structure, design guidance, PowerPoint and Beamer workflows, timing advice, visual review steps, and optional AI image generation.
skill.summary: Plan, design, generate, and validate scientific slide decks for research talks.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Most static warnings are false positives from Markdown examples, LaTeX notation, and presentation design prose. Confirmed risks are limited to OpenRouter network calls, API key handling, local file writes, subprocess execution, optional privileged installation guidance, and broad .env loading. No prompt injection or malicious exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: API key handling uses command-line arguments in the wrapper script.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer environment variables or secure prompt input, and avoid forwarding API keys through subprocess arguments.

remediation.issue: AI image generation sends prompts and optional attached images to OpenRouter.
remediation.suggestion: Add explicit user confirmation before uploading attachments, and document the external service and data sent.

remediation.issue: The generator searches parent directories for .env files.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict dotenv loading to an explicit project path or require the user to opt in to parent-directory search.

remediation.issue: Documentation includes sudo installation and parent-directory helper script commands.
remediation.suggestion: Remove privileged install commands from agent-facing steps and reference packaged tools without ../ traversal.

remediation.issue: Presentation validation compiles LaTeX through pdflatex.
remediation.suggestion: Run LaTeX compilation in a restricted temporary directory with shell escape disabled and clear warnings for untrusted files.

content.value_statement: Researchers need clear slides that fit talk length and audience. This skill helps plan, design, generate, validate, and refine scientific presentations.
actual_capabilities: Plans structures for conference talks, seminars, defenses, grant pitches, and journal clubs.
Provides PowerPoint and LaTeX Beamer guidance with reusable templates and design references.
Uses bundled scripts to generate AI slide images and combine image slides into PDF.
Validates slide count, timing, file type, file size, and basic PowerPoint text issues.
Converts PDF slides to images for visual inspection and iterative review.
Guides data visualization simplification for readable presentation figures.
limitations: AI image generation requires an OpenRouter API key and sends prompts to an external service.
Generated visuals may contain errors and need human scientific review.
Citation quality depends on sources supplied by the user or other research tools.
PowerPoint workflows may require a separate PPTX skill or local presentation tooling.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Conference Talk
use_cases.description: Create a focused 10 to 20 minute research deck with a clear story, readable figures, and tight timing.

use_cases.title: Build a Thesis Defense
use_cases.description: Organize a longer defense presentation with background, methods, results, conclusions, and backup slides.

use_cases.title: Review a Lab Seminar
use_cases.description: Check slide count, visual clarity, pacing, contrast, and common presentation problems before delivery.

prompt_templates.title: Plan My Talk
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a scientific slide deck for a 15 minute conference talk. My topic is [topic], audience is [audience], and key result is [result].

prompt_templates.title: Design a Visual Outline
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a slide-by-slide outline with titles, one main idea per slide, suggested visuals, citation needs, and timing for [talk type].

prompt_templates.title: Create a Beamer Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Beamer guidance to structure a [duration] scientific talk with equations, figures, backup slides, and a validation checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Audit an Existing Deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my presentation for narrative flow, slide density, figure readability, timing, contrast, and specific fixes before I present.

output_examples.input: A 15 minute conference talk about a new machine learning method for biomedical images.
output: A 15 to 18 slide structure with a short hook, minimal methods, three results sections, and a concise conclusion.
Suggested visuals for each slide, including a pipeline diagram, simplified performance chart, and comparison figure.
Timing checkpoints that reserve most of the talk for results.

output_examples.input: An existing seminar deck feels crowded and hard to follow.
output: A prioritized review of text-heavy slides, unreadable figures, weak transitions, and pacing risks.
Concrete slide-level changes such as splitting dense figures, increasing labels, and moving details to backup slides.

output_examples.input: A thesis defense needs a consistent visual style and Beamer template.
output: A defense-oriented deck plan with background, research questions, methods, main chapters, implications, and appendix material.
Recommendations for Beamer theme selection, slide hierarchy, typography, and final validation.

best_practices: Start with the audience, talk length, and one to three core messages before making slides.
Use large figures, minimal text, high contrast, and one main idea per slide.
Validate the final deck visually and rehearse with timing checkpoints.
anti_patterns: Do not copy dense paper figures directly into slides without simplifying labels and panels.
Do not use long paragraphs or many bullets as a speaking script.
Do not rely on generated images without checking scientific accuracy and readability.

faq.question: Can this skill create PowerPoint presentations?
faq.answer: It provides PowerPoint design guidance and visual-generation workflows. Full editable PPTX creation may require a separate PPTX skill.

faq.question: Can this skill create LaTeX Beamer slides?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes Beamer templates and guidance for conference talks, seminars, and thesis defenses.

faq.question: Does AI image generation run locally?
faq.answer: No. The bundled AI image script sends prompts and optional attachments to OpenRouter.

faq.question: Does it check scientific accuracy?
faq.answer: It helps structure and review presentations, but users must verify claims, citations, data, and generated visuals.

faq.question: What presentation lengths are supported?
faq.answer: The guidance covers short conference talks, seminars, defenses, grant pitches, journal clubs, and tutorials.

faq.question: Can it help review an existing deck?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides checklists and scripts for slide count, timing, PDF image review, and visual quality checks.
